title: Frames, Signatures and Joints: an experimental study of exact, stochastic and GPU solvers for Eternity II-type edge-matching puzzles
description: Exact (frames and signatures, versions 1 to 4.7), stochastic (joints system, version 5) and GPU (version 6) solvers for Eternity II-type edge-matching puzzles, developed between 29 September and 3 October 2026. Includes source code, test boards and generators, logs of all experiments (including negative results), a technical article, and SHA-256 hashes of every version timestamped with OpenTimestamps. The methods, ideas and decisions are the author's; the implementation and documentation were produced with the assistance of AI tools (Anthropic's Claude) under his direction. The official Eternity II piece list is not included.
